title: EditorSettings
description: Which external editors this machine can open a diff in, and the command the user configured for one the host does not discover. Returned whole by editor.describe and by editor.save, so the renderer replaces its state rather than merging. There is no preferred editor here on purpose: the diff panel offers a button per editor that is actually available, which is a shorter road to the same place than a default nobody set.

vsCodeAvailable.description: True when the code command line was found. False is a fact about this machine, not a failure: the button is absent rather than dead.

visualStudioAvailable.description: True when a Visual Studio installation was found. Always false away from Windows, where there is none to find.

customDiffCommand.description: Command template for comparing two files, with {left} and {right} standing for them. Empty when the user has configured none, and the custom button is then absent. The first word is the executable and the rest are separate arguments; no shell is involved, so quoting and redirection mean nothing here.

customOpenCommand.description: Command template for opening one file, with {file} and {line} standing for it. Used where a comparison is impossible — an added file has no committed side. Empty when the user has configured none.
